body.title: Senior Software Engineer
body.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable backend services, mentoring junior developers, and driving technical excellence across the organization.
requirements: 5+ years of professional software development experience
Strong proficiency in Python and/or Node.js
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Solid understanding of database design (SQL and NoSQL)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
